context: This criteria evaluates whether the solution correctly uses the request package's streaming capabilities to pipe HTTP responses directly to file streams without buffering entire responses in memory.

checklist.name: pipe() method usage
checklist.description: Uses request().pipe() to stream the response to a destination

checklist.name: File stream destination
checklist.description: Pipes to fs.createWriteStream() for writing directly to files

checklist.name: No buffering
checklist.description: Avoids buffering entire response by using streaming instead of callbacks with body parameter

checklist.name: Stream events
checklist.description: Listens to stream events like 'end', 'error', or 'close' for completion/error handling

checklist.name: Multiple downloads
checklist.description: Correctly handles multiple concurrent streaming downloads
